messages:
sam: Quick flag  noticed meter timestamps from MicroNode (hardware partner) are drifting ~2-3 minutes vs server time; causes occasional entitlement window misses and small billing mismatches.

anya: Hmm. Do we have a sample? can we see a side-by-side of device_ts vs receipt_ts?

sam: pasted one line we pulled from the ingestion log: `device_ts=2026-04-10T12:00:00`, `receipt_ts=2026-04-10T12:03:05Z`, partner_id=micronode-9

leo: That 3m gap pushes some events past the rolling-hour boundary and our hourly rollup drops them if TTL expired. How often is this happening?

sam: Roughly 0.6% of events last 24h, concentrated in APAC regions.

vendor-clock: We're the Micronode ops team. We pushed a clock-sync update last week that might be misapplied on older firmware. we'll ship a hotfix to force NTP sync on boot. ETA ~6 hours.

anya: Short term, propose two mitigations:
1) In ingest: accept device_ts if receipt_ts - device_ts <= 10m and tag `inferred_delay=true` so it counts toward entitlement.
2) Emit metric `device_clock_drift_ms` by partner and region and alert if >1% events >5m drift in 10m window.

leo: Agree. Also add a reconciliation job to find affected hourly windows and mark them for backfill so billing isn't lost. backfill should run with `correction_id=micronode-clockfix-20260410`.

billing-bot: Alert: 14 tenant accounts affected; potential credit exposure estimated ~$320. Finance review required.

vendor-clock: We'll run a controlled firmware patch and send a test heartbeat after forced NTP. will post status here when done.

sam: Action items: anya (ingest tolerant accept + metric), leo (backfill plan + correction_id), vendor (firmware + test heartbeat). reconvene after test heartbeat. :thumbsup:
